title: METATAC V.1 Protocol
author: Honggui Wu
materials: 200 µL Omni-ATAC lysis buffer 50 µL for each reaction, mix 200 µL ATAC-RSB with 2 µL 10% IGEPAL CA630 IGEPAL CA-630 Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #I8896-50ML , 2 µL 10 Tween 20 Tween 20 Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #170-6606-MSDS , 2 µL 1% digitonin Digitonin, 40ul Promega Catalog #G9441 . Freshly prepare before use.

1 mL 2 x TD buffer mix 20 µL 1 M TAPS pH 8.5, 10 µL 1 M MgCl2, 200 µL DMF NN-Dimethylformamide anhydrous Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #D4551-250ML , and bring the final volume to 1 mL with nuclease-free H2O. Store the buffer at -20 °C for up to several months.

FACS sort single 7-AAD positive nuclei to a 96-well PCR plate, containing 1 µL nuclei lysis buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 20 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA pH 8.0, 15 mM DTT, 0.1% SDS, 60 µg/mL QIAGEN protease). If not proceed immediately, seal the plate with Aluminum Sealing Film (Axygen, PCR-AS-600), and store at -80°C for several months without lysis. All liquid transfer steps can be done with a multichannel pipette or with an automated liquid handler system (e.g., Beckman Biomek FXP liquid handler, Echo 525 acoustic liquid handler system). Here, we use Echo 525 to handle all the liquid transfer steps, which process 20 plates each time. For cell lysis buffer, we use Echo 525 to aliquot with 384PP_AQ_BP calibration, 45 s/plate.

steps.title: Prepare ATAC Resuspension Buffer (ATAC-RSB)
steps.instruction: Prepare 5 mL of ATAC resuspension buffer by mixing 50 µL 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 7.5), 10 µL 5 M NaCl, and 15 µL 1 M MgCl2, then bring the final volume to 5 mL with nuclease-free H2O.

substeps.instruction: Store the buffer at -20 °C for up to several months.

steps.title: Prepare Omni-ATAC Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Freshly prepare 600 µL of Omni-ATAC wash buffer (150 µL per reaction) by mixing 600 µL ATAC-RSB with 6 µL 10% Tween 20.

steps.title: Prepare 2x STOP Buffer Mix
steps.instruction: Freshly prepare 1 mL of 2x STOP buffer by mixing 80 µL 0.5 M EDTA, 10 µL 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), and 10 µL 0.1 M spermidine, then bring the final volume to 1 mL with nuclease-free H2O.

steps.title: Anneal META16 Transposon
steps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µL annealing reaction using the following components: 5 µL 10x Annealing Buffer (500 mM NaCl, 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 10 mM EDTA), 2.5 µL 100 µM META16 Adapter (5 µM final), 5 µL 50 µM 19bp ME (5 µM final), and 37.5 µL H2O.

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly.
Run annealing program: 95 °C for 1 min, gradual cooling at -0.1 °C every 3s for 700 cycles down to 25 °C, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Assemble META16 Transposome
steps.instruction: Mix 25 µL 5 µM Tn5 transposase (expressed from pTXB1-Tn5 or purchased from Vazyme s111-01) and 25 µL 5 µM annealed META16 transposon.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 21-24 °C for 30 min, protected from light.
Store assembled transposome (final concentration 1.25 µM dimer) at -80 °C for up to six months.

steps.title: Harvest and Prepare Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest fresh culture in a 15 mL or 50 mL conical centrifuge tube at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 min at room temperature.
Wash twice with 1x PBS (pH 7.4).
Count cells and stain with Trypan blue to ensure viability >90%.
Aliquot 50,000 cells into a 200 µL PCR tube (prepare 2-3 replicates for FACS).
For cryopreserved samples: thaw at 37 °C water bath, wash once with ice-cold PBS, count, and aliquot 50,000 cells.

steps.title: Lysis of Cells
steps.instruction: Pellet 50,000 viable cells at 500 x g for 5 min at 4 °C in a swing bucket centrifuge and carefully remove supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL ice-cold Omni-ATAC lysis buffer, pipette up and down 10 times, and incubate on ice for 3 min (extend to 5-10 min for digestive system samples).
Wash out lysis by adding 150 µL ice-cold Omni-ATAC wash buffer and inverting the tube 3 times to mix.
Pellet nuclei at 500 x g for 10 min at 4 °C in a swing bucket centrifuge.
Wash once with 50 µL ice-cold Omni-ATAC wash buffer and pellet again at 500 x g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Perform Transposition
steps.instruction: Prepare the Transposition mix (per reaction: 12.5 µL 2x TD buffer, 9.375 µL PBS, 0.25 µL 1% Digitonin, 0.25 µL 10% Tween, and META16 Transposome).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate all supernatant without disrupting the pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 25 µL of transposition mixture by pipetting up and down 10 times and transfer to a 1.5 mL Lo-bind tube.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes in a thermomixer at 1000 RPM.
Add 25 µL 2x Stop buffer and incubate on ice for 10 min.

steps.title: Stain and Lyse Nuclei
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL 0.5% BSA (prepared by dissolving 0.25 g BSA in 50 mL 1x PBS pH 7.4) and 5 µL 7-AAD to stain nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Seal the plate with PCR sealing film (Bio-Rad MSB1001).
Incubate at 65 °C for 15 min for lysis.
Add 1 µL 3% Triton X-100 to quench SDS, spin down in a plate centrifuge, and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Preamplification
steps.instruction: Prepare preamplification mix (per reaction: 3 µL 2x Q5 master mix, 0.192 µL 1x META16 primer mix [100 nM each], 0.05 µL 100 mM MgCl2, 0.758 µL H2O, and 2 µL cell lysate).

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 4 µL of the mix to each well, spin down, and vortex.
Run thermocycling: 72 °C for 5 min; 98 °C for 30 s; 16 cycles of [98 °C for 10 s, 62 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 1 min]; 72 °C for 5 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Cell Barcoding
steps.instruction: Use a 12 x 8 barcode combination by premixing 12 META16-ADP1 and 8 META16-ADP2 barcodes into 96 combinations.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.45 µL of one of the 96 barcode mixes to each well.
Run thermocycling: 98 °C for 30 s; 5 cycles of [98 °C for 10 s, 62 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 1 min]; 72 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Library Preparation and Purification
steps.instruction: Pool a whole plate (typically 200 µL/plate) and extract DNA using ZYMO DCC5.

substeps.instruction: Perform library amplification: 98 °C for 30 s; 2 cycles of [98 °C for 10 s, 68 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 1 min]; 72 °C for 5 min.
Purify with ZYMO DCC5, then purify with 1.1 x SPRI beads to remove primer dimers.
Analyze fragments using Agilent Fragment Analyzer DNF474 kit to ensure periodic nucleosome patterns.

steps.title: Sequencing
steps.instruction: Sequence the sample on an Illumina HiSeq 4000 or NovaSeq sequencer with 9 Gb/plate.
